correctness.rationale: At rank N-2, Pfaffian differential represents the decomposable two-vector spanning wedge^2(kernel A). Restriction to allowed entries vanishes iff this bivector lies in the span of the k disjoint forbidden coordinate bivectors; Pluecker on two disjoint pair edges forces only one coefficient, so a forbidden 2-coordinate kernel pair and two zero rows result. At rank<=N-4 all Pfaffian derivatives vanish. Parameter A=B J_r B^T with r=N-4 has k independent irreducible isotropy quadrics b_(2i-1) J b_(2i)=0 on disjoint row pairs, giving an integral rank locus of expected codimension six in ambient. A generic 4-dimensional kernel avoids any forbidden coordinate pair; restriction to wedge^2 kernel is surjective, and Pfaffian Schur reduces to a 6-parameter nondegenerate quadratic. At a zero-row-pair component, Pfaffian Schur reduces to u B^(-1) v^T, a nondegenerate form in 2(N-2) variables. R1/S2 proves normality. Independent GF101 checks compare explicit Pfaffian-minor gradients with predicted strata at N=6 k=1,3 and N=8 k=2, including forced zero-row-pair witnesses. A separate explicit rank-2 N=6 k=3 matrix built from three proportional forbidden pairs has Hessian rank exactly six over GF101. These checks support but do not prove the all-N statement.

value.rationale: A natural sparsity-pattern family has a complete singular-stratum classification and exact normal quadratic slices of two different ranks, information not delivered by general rank-locus geometry. This is a meaningful structural classification across unbounded matrix orders and matching sizes.

final_claim: For even N=2m>=6 and 1<=k<=m in characteristic zero, an alternating N x N matrix with k disjoint prescribed offdiagonal zero entries has Pfaffian hypersurface with complete reduced singular locus equal to one irreducible rank<=N-4 component codim 5 inside X plus k linear zero-row-pair components codim 2N-5; their generic nondegenerate transverse quadratic forms have ranks six and 2(N-2), and X is integral normal CM Gorenstein.
limitations: Characteristic zero, N even >=6, 1<=k<=N/2, matching zero pattern only.
Reduced support/generic transverse germs, not arbitrary sparse matrices or nongeneric intersections.
